hypothesis: The documented time-series momentum effect in government-bond futures transfers to liquid physical UCITS Treasury ETFs and can diversify equity timing and CAT swing risk.
academic_basis: Moskowitz, Ooi and Pedersen (2012), Time Series Momentum, documents trend persistence across liquid bond futures among 58 instruments.

instruments.name: iShares USD Treasury Bond 7-10yr UCITS ETF
iShares USD Treasury Bond 20+yr UCITS ETF

rule.decision: last observed trading session of each month
rule.signal: adjusted close strictly greater than adjusted close on last session twelve calendar months earlier
rule.execution: enter or exit at first observed open of next month
rule.position: 100 percent long or cash; no short, no leverage

economics.note: GBP1/GBP3 current UK minimum plus 10 bps slippage per position change; percentage accounting avoids USD/GBP quote-unit ambiguity.

selection: There is one rule and no parameter grid. Both independently priced durations must pass every gate; no winner selection or retuning.
